Women's Monthly Shop Ride

Dallas, TX · White Rock Lake · Road · Social

Women / trans / femmeNo-drop

Women's Monthly Shop Ride is a road and social group ride in Dallas, TX. It rolls second Sunday of the month at 8:00 am from Pull Through Coffee Bar. About 20 miles, no-drop, 13–15 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13–15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @pullthroughcoffeebar the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Women's Monthly Shop Ride group ride

A monthly women's ride around White Rock Lake. About 20 miles at 13 to 15 mph, no-drop. Road bikes are suggested but any bike is welcome. It lands on either the first or second Sunday, so check the shop's Facebook or Instagram.
